prompt.text: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a NEW original RimWorld in-game refrigerator BUILDING SPRITE generated from scratch, NOT a cover illustration or UI icon. Clearly an appliance with a substantial CERAMIC-COATED METAL BODY, a visible lid seam, two small lid hinges, a simple latch/handle, and a SHORT but DISTINCT DARK-INDIGO COMPRESSOR FRONT HOUSING at the SCREEN BOTTOM. The entire lower one-tenth of the cabinet silhouette is this dark-indigo service housing, not just a hairline black foot. It has two broad cooling vents, one tiny cyan linear running-status indicator and a small flush-mounted HEXAGONAL/CRYSTAL-SHAPED COOLING MODULE/control cover. Those are hard mechanical hardware, not jewels or quilted fabric. White-grey ceramic/metal main shell, pale-lavender shadow planes, deep-indigo rigid equipment panels and limited cyan accents: recognizable Nivarian industrial furniture, not a generic grey glass panel. Keep large simple flat shapes that read at around 48x96 game pixels. Thin but confident dark outer outlines; restrained industrial chamfers, no thick rounded white smartphone bezel. The central glass region is large, showing only a simple cool-grey/pale-blue empty lining with faint straight reflections. NO deep bathtub-like basin, no exaggerated internal walls, no mattress or bedding or stitched/diamond quilt pattern, no coffin, no soft upholstery, no tablet, no screen electronics, no creature heads/tails/horns, no characters, no food or items, no lettering or numbers, no logo, no wings or arrows, no particles, no glow bloom, no floor, no cast shadow or scene. Flat hand-painted RimWorld game texture, two-tone hard-surface shading, NOT glossy detailed 3D product rendering, no fine texture grain. All edges visible, small transparent outer margin. The visible FRONT HOUSING must remain a horizontal strip along the SCREEN BOTTOM, never on a side edge. This is ordinary cold-storage machinery interpreted with Nivarian white/indigo/cyan design language. VERTICAL VIEW: one tile wide and two tiles long, straight 1:2 rectangular footprint, long axis vertical on the canvas, perfectly aligned without diagonal skew or visible side-face perspective. The front housing is the short lower edge. Keep the centered glass opening roughly x=.12..88, y=.10..90 of the silhouette, with white-grey rigid side rails and the dark front service band below it.

prompt.text:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished 16:9 landscape illustrated cover for a RimWorld Nivarian sleep-in-a-freezer addon. Generate the whole poster including every letter. Output aspect ratio exactly 16:9, intended to finish at 1280 x 720.
Actual visual references: Image 1 is the new color-block Nira character and her relaxed floating curled pose; image 2 is the ONLY freezer design reference, shown from above; image 3 is the sleeping mattress design for its interior. Redraw and reinterpret all of them in one unified constructivist poster. Do not paste reference pixels.
Core story: A real deep horizontal chest freezer can fly, and Nira can comfortably rest inside it. Make the freezer unmistakably a CHEST FREEZER with a large partly OPEN hinged glass TOP LID, a visible handle, deep white sidewalls, indigo base, an open cavity and a pale pillow/mattress. The two dark vents are minor lower-side details, never the main face. This is not a wall-mounted air conditioner, not a narrow coffin, not a fridge standing vertically. Show the top opening and generous box depth in a clear three-quarter perspective.
Creative composition: the long freezer dominates the lower-right half, flying with its long axis rising gently toward the right. Its high right end carries Nira's head and shoulders, while her bent knees rest within the left part of the box on the visible mattress. Nira is seated/reclining INSIDE, not pasted floating in front: the front rim overlaps her lower legs and skirt. Her long pale hair, normal cyan horns, pointed ear, cyan curled tail and warm teal-eyed smiling face remain instantly recognizable. One hand gives a small wave. The lid opens behind her as a strong pale-blue translucent geometric plane. Her tail curves over the rim. Preserve character identity but avoid dense anime detail.
Set the typography from the freezer's flight axis: a stepped family of bold condensed sans-serif word-blocks fills the open left and upper-left space, with baseline and slab edges echoing that same gentle rising-right axis. The enormous final FLY !! becomes a strong structural block beside the box, not a tiny caption. This is a bold printmaker's composition: LARGE white, cyan, pale-lavender and deep-indigo shapes lock together; one giant cropped cyan circle and a few deep-indigo/ice-blue trapezoids imply lift and motion. Paper-white background, very little texture, crisp flat screenprint inks. No glossy product rendering, no detailed scenery, no stars, no ornamental UI borders. Keep the character, box and typography in the same simple color-block visual language.
Render the following exact complete title ONCE, preserving all words, punctuation, capitalization and the intentionally unusual grammar. It may be split into these lines, and they must read in this order:
"N.S.I.F Extend :"
"These fridges"
"are absolutely can"
"FLY !!"
Also render the addon monogram "F.A.F." once, smaller, in a restrained solid block. No other words at all.
Typography must be exceptionally clear at 640 x 360. N.S.I.F Extend : is smaller than the core title but fully readable, not microtext; use thick simple letterforms. No missing word, no duplicate title. Leave generous safe margin around all lettering and keep every character fully inside the 16:9 canvas. Light planes behind dark lettering for maximum contrast. Balance bold geometric abstraction with a visible friendly humanlike face; never turn her into a faceless angular monster. Cool Nivarian palette only: paper-white, ice-blue, cyan, pale lavender, deep indigo; no Soviet red/black.
